_readme: This is a DRAFT execution-preparation artifact, not a PRE-DATA approval.
It is not consumed by raptor.eval.prospective_freeze.validate_pre_data_approval
or execute_transport_and_raw_freeze, is not wired into any loader, and its
'decision' value is deliberately NOT a member of
pre_data_approval.allowed_decisions (APPROVED_PRE_DATA / REJECTED_PRE_DATA),
so it can never be mistaken for, or accidentally accepted as, a real
approval record even if a future caller pointed at this file by mistake.
Fields that COULD be verified locally, offline, without any archive or
network access were verified and are recorded with their real values and
evidence below.
GOVERNANCE CORRECTION: this record no longer includes an 'x64_freeze'
block. PRE-DATA approval (this record) gates ONLY ClinVar archive
acquisition (ADR-0020 stages 1-2), which has no x86-only requirement --
see raptor.eval.prospective_freeze module docstring and
docs/project/specs/clinvar-2026-08-prospective-amendment-v2.yaml
'pre_data_approval'. The ADR-0008 x64 worker / BIAS / Nirvana / resource-
manifest identity check is a SEPARATE, LATER, mandatory gate before
ADR-0020 stage 4 (BIAS/Nirvana execution or label-dependent evaluation)
-- see the sibling draft file
clinvar-2026-08-amendment-v2.scoring_stage_approval.draft.json and
raptor.eval.prospective_freeze.validate_scoring_stage_approval. That
sibling file is, and remains, unapproved and unverified from this host
for the same reason as before (this host is aarch64, not the ADR-0008
designated x86_64 worker); it does not block, and is not required for,
this PRE-DATA record.
SCOPE CORRECTION: this record also no longer includes a
'scoring_semantics_projection_sha256' field. PRE-DATA approval never
reads or depends on scoring semantics or the base eval config -- that
verification belongs solely to raptor.eval.prospective_freeze
.merge_prospective_overlay, invoked only when the effective eval config
is actually built for ADR-0020 stage 3+ scoring, never as a
precondition for ClinVar archive acquisition (stages 1-2).
_decision_note: All technical prerequisites recorded below (immutable inputs, protected tests, implementation freeze) are verified. Not APPROVED_PRE_DATA. Only @dronasrinivas may change 'decision' to APPROVED_PRE_DATA and set a real 'approved_at' timestamp strictly before the first archive GET -- that explicit human governance action is the only thing still pending for this record.

implementation_freeze._note: Repinned to the real committed implementation (was NOT_YET_COMMITTED). 'commit' is the exact 40-hex commit id; each module_hashes value is that module's canonical-LF SHA-256 computed from 'git show <commit>:<path>' (the exact committed blob, never ambient/checked-out worktree bytes -- disk bytes differ from the blob by CRLF/LF checkout normalization only, confirmed byte-identical after canonicalization).

_immutable_inputs_verification_evidence.method: WSL2 raptor venv, offline: canonical_lf_sha256 recomputed from disk bytes; git_blob_sha1 recomputed via 'git rev-parse HEAD:<path>' (GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE explicit) to correctly account for .gitattributes 'text eol=crlf' normalization
_immutable_inputs_verification_evidence.result: all 12 immutable_inputs entries, the historical_terminal_result artifact, and the tsc2_scoring_semantics_projection sha256 matched their registration-spec pins exactly; 0 mismatches
